caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with two short sides that are curved at the top, each featuring an oval cutout serving as a handle. The box has interlocking joints visible at the corners where the sides are connected. The wood is rendered in shades of light brown and tan, with slight shading on the interior surfaces and beneath the box to suggest depth and shadow. The box sits on a plain, off-white background with "Carrier or tray" written in gray text below it. There are small handwritten notes and numbers in the bottom corners of the page.
title: Shaker Tray
